summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Quality-First Job Matching features. All 26 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI testing confirms all new profile fields (Work Authorization, Industries, Seniority Level) and job search match details (match_score, match_recommendation, strengths, gaps, reasoning) are working correctly. Fixed a critical bug in job search where NoneType concatenation was causing 500 errors.

fixed_bugs.issue: Job search failing with 'unsupported operand type(s) for +: NoneType and str' when job_city or job_state is None
fixed_bugs.fix: Changed job.get('job_city', '') to (job.get('job_city') or '') to handle None values properly

Backend: Profile GET returns new fields (work_authorization, industries, open_to_any_industry, seniority_level)
Backend: Profile PUT accepts all work_authorization values (citizen, permanent_resident, work_permit, require_sponsorship)
Backend: Profile PUT accepts industries array (max 3)
Backend: Profile PUT accepts open_to_any_industry boolean
Backend: Profile PUT accepts all seniority_level values (entry, junior, mid, senior, lead, manager, director, executive)
Backend: Job search returns match_score (0-100)
Backend: Job search returns match_recommendation (strong_match, good_match, review, weak_match, skip)
Backend: Job search returns match_strengths array
Backend: Job search returns match_gaps array
Backend: Job search returns match_reasoning string
Backend: Job search returns skip_reason (null or string)
Backend: Authentication required for protected endpoints
Frontend: Profile page loads with all new cards (Work Authorization, Industries, Seniority Level)
Frontend: Work Authorization dropdown shows all 4 options and saves correctly
Frontend: Industries section shows max 3 limit with 'slots remaining' counter
Frontend: Open to any industry checkbox works
Frontend: Seniority Level dropdown shows all 8 options
Frontend: Job Search shows match_score badge (e.g., '100% Match')
Frontend: Job Search shows match_recommendation badge (e.g., 'Strong Match')
Frontend: Job Search shows match_reasoning text
Frontend: 'Show match analysis' expands to show strengths and gaps
Frontend: Profile updates show success toast notification
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: NoneType concatenation bug in server.py lines 523 and 577-581 - job_city and job_state can be None from JSearch API
seed_data_creation: Created test user with profile containing: skills (Python, JavaScript, React, AWS), job_titles (Software Engineer), preferred_locations (Remote, San Francisco), experience_years (5), salary range ($100k-$150k)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quality-First features fully tested and working. Backend job search now returns detailed match evaluation. Profile page has 3 new form sections. Job search displays match badges and expandable analysis. Test user session token is valid for 7 days.
